# Infusion altar
The infusion altar is a machine that fuses essence and items into new, more powerful ones. The central altar is surrounded by connectable pedestals onto which the required ingredients are placed.
You can examine the altar while wearing thaumaturgic goggles to see the available pedestal placement spots.
## Performing an infusion ritual
- Place a catalyst item on the central altar. - Place the required items on the surrounding pedestals. - Spray the required essence around the altar. - Power the altar and all pedestals from the grid using pipes.
The altar will start drawing in essence, and if all ritual conditions are met, the infusion process will begin.
## Chaos While the ritual is running, the altar's chaos grows - even with everything set up perfectly, the fusion process is inherently risky by nature. If a ritual condition is broken (not enough essence, an item knocked off a pedestal), chaos grows faster.
The higher the chaos, the greater the chance of a negative effect triggering each second. In the worst case, negative effects can disrupt the ritual by knocking items off pedestals or damaging the feed pipes. If that happens, you need to quickly restore the ritual's conditions, or cancel it by cutting the power.
An unpowered altar gradually loses chaos, but this takes some time, during which negative effects can still occur with a decreasing chance.
## Gaining knowledge Whatever you create with the infusion altar counts as a scientific interest. You can study the result with a thaumaturgic magnifying glass to gain knowledge.
